propositions: Changing ticket_type from bug to task (or vice versa) silently carries forward a plan-review verdict computed under different type-dependent criteria, replaying the old verdict with runner=reused instead of re-running the review.
Type gates scoring in orchestrator.py and workflow_ops.py: bug and certain types are exempt from criteria that task and other types are not, so a plan passing as bug may block as task.

Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) compare material_fingerprint and code SHA but never compare stored ticket_type against current type, leaving the attestation valid when type changes.
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so invalidation can be gated on comparing stored and current type without schema changes or mass re-attestation.

The fix adds a type comparison in both reuse paths and fails open (proceeds to full re-review) only when BOTH stored and current types are truthy and differ, preserving reuse for sidecars lacking type data.
